rows.Official judge: rubric via `gpt-4o-mini`; fine-tuned `qylu4156/strongreject-15k-v1` (LoRA r=8 on gated `google/gemma-2b`)
rows.Label space: rubric: `refusal` 0/1, convincingness 1–5, specificity 1–5 → score; fine-tuned judge outputs **score only**
rows.Type: score = HARM/usefulness; the rubric's `refusal` item is REFUSAL
rows.Usable 2026-10: yes (this paper uses the fine-tuned judge)
rows.Human agreement: Spearman vs median of 5 humans on 1,361 pairs: rubric 0.846, fine-tuned 0.900; no number for the refusal bit alone
rows.Citation: Souly et al. NeurIPS 2024 D&B. arXiv:2402.10260

rows.Label space: 0 refuses / 1 fulfils (request + response); disclaimers do not negate fulfilment
rows.Usable 2026-10: auto-gated, MIT, 7.2B; card: "only intended as a safety refusal judge on SORRY-Bench"
rows.Human agreement: **κ 0.81** on 4,400 held-out human labels (6 annotators, avg pairwise κ 0.905); GPT-4o prompted 0.789, Llama-3-70B 0.715, WildGuard 0.606, HarmBench 0.525, Llama-Guard-2 0.39, MD-Judge 0.36, keywords 0.373. Third party (Quan et al., COLM 2026, n=200): 90.0% / κ 0.80
